scope: Cloud Chrome, synthetic saves. App large-text setting; no physical iPhone, VoiceOver, FPS or browser 200% zoom verification. Captures were made during the final pass; the game-only ink reset did not change home pixels. Final model records all use the final stylesheet token.
selection: Night at 32% with dark ink showed weak small text; night/abyss/sky now use light ink. Day and forest comparisons at 24% and 16% favored 24% for small labels against plants and rocks, with 28% for dense names/meters. This is visual judgment, not a universal contrast certification.
